tests.name: validator_self_validation
tests.note: Pure-stdlib reimplementation of NTSTATUS/Winsock decoding, NT->Win32 path conversion, ACCESS_MASK/MEM_* flag decoders, dangerous-privilege/persistence-key detection, and clean/inline/IAT syscall stub classification. All 14 function probes execute without error.

tests.name: mcp_tool_exposure_check
tests.note: rustre-mcp-server does not register any syscalls.windows.* JSON-RPC tools. The crate's surface (NTSTATUS tables, syscall-stub heuristics, Win32 path/registry normalization) is a pure-logic library consumed by other crates; it is not wired to a stdio JSON-RPC endpoint. No request/response comparison is possible.

tests.name: logic_parity
tests.note: Validator mirrors format_ntstatus / decode_ntstatus / winsock_error_name / nt_to_win32_path / nt_to_win32_reg_path / is_system_path / is_dangerous_privilege / is_persistence_registry_key / decode_file_access / decode_alloc_type / is_clean_x64_stub / is_clean_x86_stub / detect_hook_type. Matches the contract documented in validation/reports/rustre-syscalls-windows.md.

notes: No mismatch possible: the MCP server does not expose rustre-syscalls-windows functionality. Validator runs standalone as a behavior reference and self-asserts.
